item.title: DAVID BLACKMON: Chris Wright Delivers Lightning-Fast Progress In Venezuela
item.description: ExxonMobil CEO Darren Woods made big news during President Donald Trump’s White House meeting with oil and gas industry leaders when he told the President his company considers Venezuela to be “uninvestable” under current conditions. On Sunday - just six weeks later - U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright detailed how those conditions are rapidly changing in favorable ways.

item.title: New Report Details O’Keefe’s Undercover Work Involving Antifa-Affiliated Group
item.description: James O’Keefe is once again putting activist networks under a microscope — this time overseas. In newly released undercover footage, O’Keefe’s team infiltrated Cyklopen, an autonomous cultural center in Stockholm frequently described by critics as an ANTIFA organizing hub. What they found, they argue, offers a rare look at how loosely organized activist circles operate […]

item.title: CNN Program Stirs Debate Over Portrayal of Religious and Political Figures
item.description: Oh boy. This Sunday, CNN is rolling out a full hour-long documentary hosted by Pamela Brown on what it calls the rise of “Christian nationalism.” The framing? A warning. The implication? A threat. According to previews, Brown zeroes in on the memorial service for conservative activist Charlie Kirk, who was assassinated, as a defining example […]

item.title: WALKER WILDMON: A Vacancy That Could Redefine The Supreme Court
item.description: President Donald Trump’s recent mention of Republican Texas Sen. item.title: Medical Examiner Rules ‘Pulp Fiction’ Actor Peter Greene’s Death Accidental
